completion_data.completion_summary: Dispatch 34 closed sub-phase 15.3 and with it Phase 15. The new module Bridge.lean proves the equality the whole computed-liveness development exists for -- G.Live s p <-> (p, s) in G.liveT at a window time -- by a position-level splice of a forward and a backward walk into a LabRun, and yields decidableLive, the instance Phase 17's checker is written against. Dispatch 33's condition-set blocker is resolved by taking its own recommendation: Basic.lean gains (C3b) BoxLabelFaithful with a two-directional window reduction, consumed at exactly one place and therefore cheap to reverse. Three of the plan's own instructions were corrected rather than absorbed: the bridge cannot be stated at a general time because FoldF and FoldB are disjoint away from the diagonal; the soundness direction does not factor into forward and backward halves although the completeness direction does, so no fwdLive_iff_mem_fwdLiveT exists or should be sought; and 15.3's gate is unreachable by evaluation, so Fixture.liveT_ne_empty_and_ne_verts discharges it by proof, using the bridge in both directions.
